import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

index = 0
T = int(data[index])
index += 1

results = []

for _ in range(T):
    N = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    A = list(map(int, data[index:index + N]))
    index += N
    P = list(map(lambda x: int(x) - 1, data[index:index + N]))
    index += N
    Q = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    
    for _ in range(Q):
        op = data[index]
        if op == '1':
            A = [A[P[i]] for i in range(N)]
        elif op == '2':
            x = int(data[index + 1]) - 1
            y = int(data[index + 2]) - 1
            A[x], A[y] = A[y], A[x]
            index += 2
        else:
            x = int(data[index + 1]) - 1
            results.append(str(A[x]))
            index += 1
        index += 1

print('\n'.join(results))
